style: 2D hand-drawn illustrated storybook animation (flat soft colours, paper/gouache texture, ink outlines; deep-blue night + amber lamp)
format: 1280x720, 24 fps, H.264 with an AAC audio track from the model (ambience; mute or duck it)
character_reference: keyframes/character_2d.png (front/side/back turnaround); in-scene side view: keyframes/S2_start.png and keyframes/S2_last_frame_from_video.png

S1.on_screen: Dark blue moonlit bedroom. The amber bedside clock reads 03:07 and the lamp is off. The camera pushes in slowly from a wide shot toward the bed. The grandmother wakes, looks up, turns and pushes herself up to sitting (around 3.5–5 s).
S1.flaws: The clock reads 03:07 in every frame, but the digits are slightly soft/stylised. The push-in is fairly fast in the first second. While she sits up (~3.5–4.5 s) her face looks a little older and more lined than on the character sheet. She sits up quite quickly. No other text.
S1.alternate: variants/S1_alt_t1.mp4 (closer framing with the clock in the foreground, no lamp on the nightstand, slower and calmer wake-up; she ends sitting at the bed edge. It is also clean.)

S2.on_screen: Static side view, plain low bed, no device, lamp on. She sits on the bed edge in profile, pushes on the mattress and rises to about halfway (~2–3 s). Her knees tremble, drawn as small motion lines (~3.5 s). She wobbles and drops back onto the bed edge (~4–4.5 s), then sits with her head bowed, tired (4.5–7 s).
S2.flaws: Over the last 2.5 s she sits in a near-side view: her body is turned about 20–30° toward the camera, so it is not a strict profile (keyframes/S2_start.png is the strict profile if the transition needs one). The drop back down is soft rather than heavy. Small facial redraw changes around 4–5 s.

S10.on_screen: Static shot from behind of a dim blue hallway. She walks slowly away toward a small amber plug-in night light beside a half-open door.
S10.flaws: She moves forward very little: the steps are visible but she covers only a short distance in 6 s, so it reads almost as walking in place. The right two-thirds of the frame is an empty dark wall (the image model composed it that way); crop or reframe if needed. No device (as briefed).
